Synopsis:
Elia, Belgium's electricity transmission grid operator, has secured a €1 billion EIB loan — the largest ever EIB energy infrastructure loan in Benelux — to finance the Princess Elisabeth Island, an artificial offshore hub 45km off the Belgian coast. The island will interconnect future offshore wind farms to the Belgian grid, serving as a cornerstone of Belgium's and Europe's offshore wind expansion and energy security strategy.
